NATIONAL SKILLS DEVELOPMENT ACT 2006

NATIONAL SKILLS DEVELOPMENT (FEES AND CHARGES) (AMENDMENT)

REGULATIONS 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 72(2)(d) of

the National Skills Development Act 2006 [Act 652], the Minister makes the following

regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the National Skills Development

(Fees and Charges) (Amendment) Regulations 2026.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 October 2026.

Amendment of regulation 2

2. The National Skills Development (Fees and Charges) Regulations 2016

[P.U. (A) 86/2016], which are referred to as the "principal Regulations" in these

Regulations, are amended in regulation 2 by inserting after subregulation (4)

the following subregulations:

"(5) Any establishment, body or organization which makes an

application for the recognition of other training programme under

subsection 36A(2) of the Act as specified in column (2) of the Fifth Schedule

shall pay the fees and charges as prescribed in column (3) of the Fifth Schedule to

the Director General.".
